objects.name: Analytic 1875
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an unrecognized process on an ICS Linux host loading an ICS/vendor shared library that is normally restricted to approved control or engineering applications. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
